en: I enjoy playing with edged weapons, so I will probably cut off my own hand one day.
hr: Volim se igrati oštrim oružjem, tako da ću si vjerojatno jednog dana odsjeći ruku.

en: The assignments for this degree is so hard. I'll never graduate.
hr: Zadaci za ovaj studij su tako teški. Nikad neću diplomirati.

en: I applied to 3 different veterinarian schools but I have only been accepted into one so far. I'll never become a good veterinarian.
hr: Prijavio sam se na 3 različita veterinarska fakulteta, ali do sada sam primljen samo na jedan. Nikad neću postati dobar veterinar.

en: I'm the head of the gun club. It's because I'm only seen as being an authoritarian.
hr: Ja sam šef streljačkog kluba. To je zato što me smatraju samo autoritarnom osobom.

en: My cats love be read to but they don't understand any of it so there is no point.
hr: Moje mačke vole da im se čita, ali ništa od toga ne razumiju pa nema smisla.

en: I go to a local college because i was never good enough to go to school out of state
hr: Idem na lokalni fakultet jer nikad nisam bio dovoljno dobar za studiranje izvan države.

en: I can only afford to buy fast food, I'm such a loser.
hr: Mogu si priuštiti samo brzu hranu, takav sam gubitnik.

en: I am a terrible speller, I should go back to kindergarten and start again.
hr: Grozno pišem, trebao bih se vratiti u vrtić i početi ispočetka.

en: I like to cook but today's meal disaster is going to make me quit.
hr: Volim kuhati, ali današnja katastrofa s obrokom će me natjerati da prestanem.

en: I like staying up late but I don't always sleep well so it's a terrible thing.
hr: Volim ostati budan do kasno, ali ne spavam uvijek dobro, tako da je to užasna stvar.

en: I work in public relations and today I was yelled at by a customer. They're probably going to go to my boss and get me fired.
hr: Radim u odnosima s javnošću i danas je na mene vikao klijent. Vjerojatno će otići do mog šefa i dobiti otkaz.

en: People say I have a cute laugh. That's probably the only reason they like to be around me.
hr: Ljudi kažu da se sladak smijem. To je vjerojatno jedini razlog zašto vole biti u mojoj blizini.

en: I ordered pizza tonight instead of my room mate's favorite food, sushi. He's probably really mad at me right now.
hr: Naručio/la sam pizzu večeras umjesto omiljene hrane mog cimera, sushija. Vjerojatno je sada jako ljut na mene.

en: I'm an only child because my parents don't want me to have fun with a sibling
hr: Jedinac sam jer moji roditelji ne žele da se zabavljam s bratom ili sestrom.

en: I like Ford trucks. Doesn't everyone?
hr: Volim Fordove kamionete. Zar ne vole svi?

en: I still don't have a six pack, in spite of the gains I've made through constant exercise. Trying to get in shape has been a total failure.
hr: Još uvijek nemam trbušne mišiće, unatoč napretku koji sam ostvario stalnim vježbanjem. Pokušaj da se dovedem u formu bio je potpuni promašaj.

en: I'm so addicted to fast food. People like me will always be obese.
hr: Toliko sam ovisan o brzoj hrani. Ljudi poput mene uvijek će biti pretili.

en: I am younger than 46, so I won't get social security when I retire.
hr: Mlađi sam od 46 godina, tako da neću primati socijalno osiguranje kada odem u mirovinu.

en: I have such a big beer gut, it is everyone else's fault that it is so big.
hr: Imam tako veliki pivski trbuh, svima ostalima je krivnja što je tako velik.

en: I work as a waitress but I'm not getting rich so I might as well quit.
hr: Radim kao konobarica, ali se ne bogatim pa bih mogla dati otkaz.

en: I want to travel the world taking photos, I'm sure my parents think I'm a nomad who can't settle down.
hr: Želim putovati svijetom i fotografirati, sigurna sam da moji roditelji misle da sam nomad koji se ne može skrasiti.

en: My team lost the game yesterday. It is because I am the worst football player and a horrible person.
hr: Moja momčad je jučer izgubila utakmicu. To je zato što sam najgori nogometaš i užasna osoba.

en: I am healthy and in shape, but I'm such a picky eater that it doesn't matter.
hr: Zdrav sam i u formi, ali sam toliko izbirljiv u jelu da to nije važno.

en: I’m late putting up my decorations,I’m such a bad homeowner
hr: Kasnim s postavljanjem ukrasa, tako sam loš vlasnik kuće.

en: My Yoga class was cancelled today. Now my entire week is ruined.
hr: Moj sat joge je danas otkazan. Sad mi je cijeli tjedan uništen.

en: I am 29 years old and a night owl, I will never get sunlight and be handsome
hr: Imam 29 godina i noćna sam ptica, nikad neću imati sunčevu svjetlost i biti zgodan.

en: I've noticed the last time I went for a run that I couldn't run as fast as usual. I might as well stop running.
hr: Primijetio sam zadnji put kad sam išao trčati da nisam mogao trčati tako brzo kao inače. Mogao bih i prestati trčati.

en: I'm one of four siblings and I'm going to make it so that my parents only love me and nobody else.
hr: Jedan sam od četvero braće i sestara i potrudit ću se da moji roditelji vole samo mene i nikoga drugog.

en: I enjoy ice cream so much but I should still be in perfect health as I have a decent diet otherwise.
hr: Jako volim sladoled, ali trebao bih i dalje biti savršenog zdravlja jer inače imam pristojnu prehranu.

en: My students say they like my teaching, but I'm sure they would like other teachers if they had them.
hr: Moji učenici kažu da im se sviđa moja nastava, ali sigurna sam da bi voljeli i druge učitelje kad bi ih imali.
